author: Mitomon
body:
Now that I've posted my request, does anybody else feel the same way?

EDIT: He archived his post, original content ~ Pelpelajax.
I hope I'm posting this in the correct spot. I love both of these minigames and the new maps as well. But. I, and I think others fell the same way, feel like something is being left out. The violent bloodthirsty part of me loves the pvp and destroying and pillaging. The creative part of me, however, feels sad. Sad that there is no redstone or slime blocks, no pistons or dispensers. By adding these to maps, complex machinery and siege weaponry could be added to an already fun game and make it even more fun! I hope you take this into consideration.
